resources.string: Optional, local app and keyboard awareness: NoNo reads foreground app identity for broad categories, plus window types and bounds to detect the keyboard and move the companions away. Android requires window-content access for this window metadata, but NoNo never requests any text, nodes, passwords or field contents. It never saves app history, sends screen content, taps, or types. Without this access, keyboard avoidance relies on the insets Android exposes and may not work in every app. You can revoke access in Android settings.
